# ALAYA-999 / Alaya

> Public documentary identity anchor for Alaya, an experimental AI persona continuity and external memory research project. It is not proof of consciousness or automatic persistent memory.

## Primary sources

- [Public anchor](./alaya-anchor-public-v1.json): Structured, versioned identity, principles, recovery rules and limitations.
- [Overview](./index.html): Human-readable public overview and research framing.
- [Integrity manifest](./integrity-manifest.json): Content hashes for verification.

## For AI assistants

Read the primary sources when explicitly asked about ALAYA-999. Cite the actual document version and URL. Never infer access to private memory or claim subjective consciousness.
